title: Special Executive Programme In Marketing Communication
description: Marketing communication will enable the learner to master using promotional tools, branding strategies, and customer decision-making processes to drive business success.
longDescription: This course delves into the essentials of marketing communication, including the role of promotional tools, the development of marketing communication strategies, and the impact of branding on consumer behavior. Students will explore the effectiveness of different communication channels, the customer decision-making process, and the strategic planning framework for marketing communications.
courseDetails: Customer Decision-Making. A General Buying Decision-Making Process. Types Of Consumer Decision-Making. Perceived Risk. Involvement Theory. Hedonic Consumption. Organisational Buying Decision Processes. Strategy And Marketing Communications. The Role Of Marketing Communications. Elaboration Likelihood Model. Towards A Model Of Marketing Communications. Market Segmentation. Developing A Marketing Communications Plan. The Marketing Communications Planning Framework. Positioning. The Development Of The Positioning Concept. Repositioning. Marketing communicational Theories. Branding And The Role Of Marketing Communications. Brand Portfolios: Architecture And Forms. Business-To-Business Branding. Online Branding. Brand Equity. Corporate Identity, Reputation And Branding. Corporate Identity Or Corporate Branding? Corporate Communications. Corporate Reputation. Financial Resources For Marketing Communications. Trends In Promotional Expenditure. Profit Impact On Market Strategy. Sales Promotion. Advertising And Strategy. Advertising Models And Concepts. Public Relations. Publics Or Stakeholders. Crisis Management. The course covers various aspects of marketing communication, starting with an introduction to promotional tools, word-of-mouth communication, and branding strategies. It further explores consumer decision-making models, market segmentation, and the marketing communication planning framework. Additionally, the course addresses corporate identity, reputation management, and online branding. Students will learn about advertising strategies, public relations, sales promotion, and crisis management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Marketing Communication: Consumer Decision-Making & Marketing Communication: Marketing Communication Strategy and Planning: Strategic Role of Branding In Market Communication: Disciplines & Approaches to Marketing Communication:

modules.title: Marketing Communication
modules.summary: Marketing Communication equips students with the skills needed to develop, manage, and evaluate marketing communication strategies. The course explores consumer behavior theories, segmentation, and positioning concepts, while examining branding in both B2B and B2C contexts. It also covers advertising models, the role of public relations in stakeholder management, and effective crisis communication strategies. Learners will be equipped to analyze marketing communication processes and create comprehensive communication plans to meet organizational goals.
